headline: Barracuda hacked amid ARTEX-powered attack surge; UnrealIRCd exploited on its KEV due date; AI agents hunt LiteLLM and Dify API keys

bullets.text: New: SecurityWeek reports Barracuda was hacked amid a surge in ARTEX-powered cyberattacks, adding to the FBI warning on the ARTEX AI hacking tool, still the only 3-outlet story. Two Barracuda flaws (CVE-2026-111560, ESG CVE-2026-116606) went on KEV 11-10 with a 11-13 deadline.

New: Google says an AI agent turned a security patch into a working exploit with no human help, shortening the gap between a fix and attacks. Separately, the FBI says North Korean hackers stole over $400 million in crypto using deepfake video calls.

Due today: UnrealIRCd CVE-2026-114713 is being exploited in attacks, and Check Point CVE-2026-123039 shares the 11-16 KEV deadline. BO Team also exploited Log4Shell in VMware vCenter to compromise a code-signing server.

Still active: SANS sees scans for LiteLLM/Starlette CVE-2026-42271 and CVE-2026-48710, and Amazon uncovered an AI agent campaign targeting LiteLLM, Dify and other apps for API keys. Copeland and unpatched Danfoss refrigeration controllers are also being probed or exposed.

Breaches: Lithuania's customs agency restored services after a cyberattack with a possible data breach. Coles is investigating an incident, Uber's breach impacts 150,000 people and Qilin claims UT Arlington; the 22 million-person French postal hack remains on the board.
Trend: SITCON 3 (ELEVATED), unchanged. The last 7 days score 1.0x the 90-day average; INC Ransom led leak-site claims with 50 this week.

actions: Barracuda: confirm CVE-2026-111560 and ESG CVE-2026-116606 are fixed, and review Barracuda appliances for signs of compromise.
UnrealIRCd and Check Point: patch CVE-2026-114713 and CVE-2026-123039 today or pull exposed systems offline, then hunt for backdoors.
LiteLLM, Dify and other AI gateways: patch CVE-2026-42271 and CVE-2026-48710, keep admin endpoints private and rotate stored API keys.
Shorten patch windows for internet-facing systems: assume exploits can follow a published fix within hours.
Finance and crypto teams: verify payment or wallet requests out of band; do not trust video calls alone.
Queue KEV fixes: Apple CVE-2024-27834 due 11-18, SonicWall SSLVPN 11-20, Outlook, Cisco BroadWorks, Openwave and Chromium 11-24.
